sayTail.text: 👂 Overheard — Lauren: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
👂 Overheard — Tariq: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
Tariq left 2 bark strips by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
💧 Sanjay eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the wood run instead.
🪵 Sanjay hauls back 13 wood. The pile grows. (543 logs now.)
Marcus heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.

— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
📋 Sanjay — 💧 Fetch water. (a natural — good pick) Sanjay nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
"Can we talk?" Declan shifts their weight. "I need something to do. Anything. Please." (Talk to Declan.)
❓ Sanjay just told you something about Marcus — says they're not really from Chicago, Illinois. Worth remembering.
📓 Codex: Marcus — jotted down what they said. Filed.

👂 Overheard — Sanjay (to Lauren): "Funny you should ask." Sanjay glances over their shoulder. "Marcus's been polishing that story. The unpolished version: from Chicago, Illinois. Keep my name out of it."
🪨 Sanjay pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (101 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Nikau telling Tomas about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tariq telling Owen about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

Tomas showed Nino the Peanut — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🌿 Miguel returns from foraging the wilds: +151 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 150 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
Miguel, counting on their fingers: "They sent extra this week. I think we're... friends? Is that the word?"
Marcus waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Thornfield with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
★ IDENTIFIED: Piquiarana. Tasty fruit, dangerous pit. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
Aria was watching. Now they know Piquiarana too.
📚 Village knowledge: Zoe taught everyone about Piquiarana. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
📺 The System wants its stars tonight.
📺 CONTEST: Gauntlet. Three waves, no rest. Survive all three and the crowd goes wild. Most don't see wave two.
📺 The System has taken You and Declan. The village holds its breath.
📺 The grab comes at dawn. One more day. Sleep if you can.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +2322 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Miguel is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
Tomas has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Zoe drew Piquiarana in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🔍 Tomas has been turning over a big shady tree; at dawn the ground beneath is strewn with fleshy cream flowers for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Tomas had the day of their life — 1716 kcal. The pantry can't take it all: 858 kcal goes in, 858 kcal is eaten at the fire.
Tariq and Declan lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Miguel leaves the foraging basket at the door. "The pantry can't take more — sitting with the elders instead."
🍽️ Tariq watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
